name: If Monsters, Why Cute?
source:
Josuiji Shinri, Field Reporter of Guild TEMPUS and a member of Holostars English, fights monsters for a living.  One day, he receives an envelope under his door with an essay suggesting that monsters could be persuaded to cooperate through love, not violence.  Shinri, feeling encouraged, takes this advice to heart as he goes about his work as a monster hunter.

[From [url=https://shinri-bday-projects.itch.io/if-monsters-why-cute]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Josuiji Shinri，公会TEMPUS的现场记者和Holostars English的成员，以与怪物战斗为生。有一天，他在门下收到一个信封，里面有一篇文章，建议可以通过爱而不是暴力来说服怪物合作。Shinri受到鼓舞，在从事怪物猎人的工作时将这个建议牢记在心。

[来自[url=https://shinri-bday-projects.itch.io/if-monsters-why-cute]itch.io[/url]]
